why: Image 1's saturated rainbow neon rings look like a pasted-in CG element: they cast almost no believable light into the room, and the colored patch they throw on the plaster wall reads as artificial. In Image 2 the dark smoked-glass sphere sits in the warm, low, single-source night light, and the cool slashes of light on the concrete wall make it read as a real room shot by an interiors photographer.
